title: Translation status
empty: No rows match the current filters.
dialog.text: This viewer blocks clipboard access. Select all, then copy (Cmd/Ctrl+C) and paste into Google Sheets.
banner.noRecords: No status records yet — run `i18n-studio init`
banner.proposal: Import proposal pending: {parts}. Old values are struck through; nothing is written until `apply`.
confirm.discard.one: Discard {n} pending change? It cannot be recovered.
confirm.discard.other: Discard {n} pending changes? They cannot be recovered.
confirm.source.one: You are editing the source language. {n} row with existing translations will become stale and need review. Save anyway?
confirm.source.other: You are editing the source language. {n} rows with existing translations will become stale and need review. Save anyway?
error.conflict: Some values changed on disk since you loaded the page. Resolve each highlighted change below; nothing was saved.
error.forbidden: The server refused the save (forbidden or read-only). Reload the page.
error.tooLarge: Too many changes for one save. Save fewer changes at a time.
help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.arrows: Arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up/Down: move between cells
help.edit: Enter or F2 (or double-click): edit the selected cell
help.commit: In the editor: Enter saves the edit, Shift+Enter adds a line, Esc cancels
help.tab: Tab / Shift+Tab: commit and move to the next / previous cell
help.space: Space: select or deselect the row
draft.dropped.one: {n} could not be restored (its row or language no longer exists).
draft.dropped.other: {n} could not be restored (their rows or languages no longer exist).
draft.conflicts.one: {n} conflicts with a change on disk; resolve it below.
draft.conflicts.other: {n} conflict with changes on disk; resolve them below.
draft.unavailable: This browser cannot keep drafts, so unsaved changes are lost if you leave the page. Save soon.
draft.tooLarge: These changes are too large to keep as a draft in this browser, so they are lost if you leave the page. Save soon.
draft.otherTab: Another browser tab changed the draft for this project. The last one to write wins; drafts are not merged.
